_comment: Signature phrases. Each may appear once per page, and only its canonical page may use it at all; everywhere else, link to the canonical page. scripts/lint-prose.py enforces this.

phrases.pattern: (paid|pay|pays|paying) for (it |twice |the season |a season )?in sleep|fund(ed|s)? (the season|a season|with sleep)|season you pay for in sleep
phrases.label: paid for in sleep
the part nobody puts on the highlight reel

phrases.pattern: not a coaching business|coaching business|not a clinic|no clinic
phrases.label: not a coaching business / not a clinic
